Below the text rule, one foot note at left margin-level. Catchword-like heading "CAPUT" at lower right, with a stray mark in the blank area.

main_text.p: Versione Pentateuchi Saadianâ diu usi sunt; donec Doctor quidam Samaritanus, Abusaid dictus, aliam in popularium usum Translationem, characteribus tamen Samaritanis, circa annum 1160. conficeret, Saadiam plerunque secutus. Extitit ea MS. penès Usserium, teste Waltono ', cui illam Usserius communicaverat. Duplex ejusdem exemplar in Bibliothecâ Regis Galliæ haberi dicitur.
main_text.head: CAPUT

page.notes: The footnote mark after "Waltono" is a superscript reference, shown as ' in the transcription. The footnote text is printed as "Prolegom. cap. II. §. 2l." with a small superscript mark; the final numeral is uncertain. The word "CAPUT" has no number printed. Blank text area below the rule contains only faint show-through and stains, not transcribed.
